api_tokens_folder_scope_check.name: api_tokens_folder_scope_check
api_tokens_folder_scope_check.value: cardinality("api_tokens"."folder_scope") > 0 and array_ndims("api_tokens"."folder_scope") = 1 and array_position("api_tokens"."folder_scope", null) is null

audit_events_actor_kind_ids_check.name: audit_events_actor_kind_ids_check
audit_events_actor_kind_ids_check.value: ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'human' and "audit_events"."actor_token_id" is null) or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'agent' and "audit_events"."actor_user_id" is null) or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_events"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_events"."actor_token_id" is null and "audit_events"."actor_name" = 'System')

audit_events_error_code_check.name: audit_events_error_code_check
audit_events_error_code_check.value: ("audit_events"."outcome" = 'success' and "audit_events"."error_code" is null) or ("audit_events"."outcome" = 'failure' and "audit_events"."error_code" is not null and char_length("audit_events"."error_code") <= 64 and "audit_events"."error_code" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$')

audit_events_target_pairing_check.name: audit_events_target_pairing_check
audit_events_target_pairing_check.value: "audit_events"."target_kind" is not null or ("audit_events"."target_id" is null and "audit_events"."target_label" is null)

auth_challenges_webauthn_purpose_check.name: auth_challenges_webauthn_purpose_check
auth_challenges_webauthn_purpose_check.value: "auth_challenges"."purpose" not in ('webauthn_registration', 'webauthn_authentication') or "auth_challenges"."webauthn_challenge" is not null

folders_parent_id_name_unique.name: folders_parent_id_name_unique
folders_parent_id_name_unique.where: "folders"."parent_id" is not null and "folders"."deleted_at" is null

folders_name_check.name: folders_name_check
folders_name_check.value: char_length("folders"."name") between 1 and 120 and strpos("folders"."name", '/') = 0 and "folders"."name" !~ '^[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]$'

folders_trash_pairing_check.name: folders_trash_pairing_check
folders_trash_pairing_check.value: ("folders"."deleted_at" is null and "folders"."deleted_by_user_id" is null and "folders"."deleted_by_token_id" is null and "folders"."deleted_by_name" is null and "folders"."trash_batch_id" is null) or ("folders"."deleted_at" is not null and "folders"."deleted_by_name" is not null and "folders"."trash_batch_id" is not null)

notes_folder_id_title_unique.name: notes_folder_id_title_unique
notes_folder_id_title_unique.where: "notes"."folder_id" is not null and "notes"."deleted_at" is null

notes_locked_by_pairing_check.name: notes_locked_by_pairing_check
notes_locked_by_pairing_check.value: ("notes"."locked_at" is null and "notes"."locked_by_user_id" is null and "notes"."locked_by_token_id" is null and "notes"."locked_by_name" is null) or ("notes"."locked_at" is not null and "notes"."locked_by_name" is not null)

notes_trash_pairing_check.name: notes_trash_pairing_check
notes_trash_pairing_check.value: ("notes"."deleted_at" is null and "notes"."deleted_by_user_id" is null and "notes"."deleted_by_token_id" is null and "notes"."deleted_by_name" is null and "notes"."trash_batch_id" is null) or ("notes"."deleted_at" is not null and "notes"."deleted_by_name" is not null and "notes"."trash_batch_id" is not null)
